description_en: Queries products by tag with paging
description_zh: 调用该接口根据标签分页查询产品列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-product-by-tags --iot-instance-id iot-v64000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --product-tag TagKey=room TagValue=102 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProductByTags

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大值是50
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The value of the product tag
fields.name: tag_value

fields.help_en: The key of the product tag
fields.name: tag_key

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

ProductInfo.description_en:
The list of product information (ProductInfo) returned if the call was successful.

The returned products are sorted in reverse chronological order by creation time
ProductInfo.description_zh:
调用成功时，返回产品信息列表（ProductInfo）。

返回的产品信息按照产品创建时间倒序排列

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the product was created

NodeType.description_en:
The node type of the product. Valid values:
0: Device. A device cannot have sub-devices attached. It can connect to IoT Platform directly or as a sub-device of a gateway.
1: Gateway. A gateway can have sub-devices attached. It has a sub-device management module, maintains the topology of sub-devices, and synchronizes the topology to IoT Platform
NodeType.description_zh:
产品的节点类型，取值：
0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备。可以直连物联网平台，也可以作为网关的子设备连接物联网平台。
1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，和将拓扑关系同步到物联网平台

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product. This is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a newly created product
ProductKey.description_zh: 产品的ProductKey。是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
